serve hello.text
expand src_var.cel src.cel
cmpenv src.cel src_var.cel 

mito -use http,collections src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src_var.cel --
post_request("${URL}", "text/plain", "request data").do_request().drop([
	"Header.Cache-Control",
	"Header.Date",
	"Header.Etag",
	"Header.Expires",
	"Header.Last-Modified",
	"Header.Server",
	"Request.Host",
	"Request.URL",
])
-- hello.text --
hello
